name: company_screener
description: Screen companies from natural-language criteria using the FMP stock screener. Supports filtering by market cap, price, volume, P/E ratio, dividend yield, beta, sector, industry, country, exchange, ROE, ROIC, and more.

prompt.description: Natural language screening query. Example: 'large cap tech stocks with pe under 20'

criteria_overrides.description: Direct field overrides bypassing prompt parsing.
